# Security review

## Change
Describe the security-relevant change and affected trust boundaries.

## Data
What customer, credential, finding or personal data is added, removed or transmitted?

## Authorization
Which identities can invoke it? How is tenant scope enforced?

## Abuse cases
List misuse, injection, privilege escalation, data leakage and denial-of-service cases considered.

## Evidence
Tests, scans, threat-model update and manual review performed.

## Residual risk
Document accepted risk and owner. Never mark external certification/pentest complete without evidence.
